title: owner: Share → view-only link is created and can be copied
anonymous visitor: the link opens a view-only deck with navigation, no editor controls, no speaker notes
Pro: owner password-protects the link; a visitor must enter it (wrong password refused, right one opens), then the owner removes it
Pro: owner sets an expiry; the dialog confirms it
owner turns the link off → it stops working immediately
owner invites a friend by email (Pro): the invitation shows as pending
friend signs up with that email, opens the invitation, accepts, and lands in the owner's deck as a collaborator
collaborator has no Share / Export, can rename the deck, and the owner sees the change
the deck appears under "Shared with me" for the friend; a stranger account cannot open it
owner removes the friend → access ends at once
